mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application WHERE stage = 'RECEIVED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application WHERE stage = 'DOC_PASS'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application WHERE stage IN ('INTERVIEW1','INTERVIEW2')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application WHERE stage = 'PASSED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application WHERE stage = 'REJECTED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interview_schedule WHERE DATE(scheduled_at) = CURDATE() AND status = 'SCHEDULED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_posting WHERE status = 'OPEN'

SELECT j.title, COUNT(a.application_id) AS cnt FROM job_posting j LEFT JOIN application a ON j.posting_id = a.posting_id WHERE j.status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY j.posting_id, j.title ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT a.application_id, a.applicant_name, a.career_year, a.stage, j.title AS posting_title FROM application a JOIN job_posting j ON a.posting_id = j.posting_id ORDER BY a.applied_at DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(applied_at,'%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM application WHERE applied_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(applied_at,'%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
